authority.summary: Drupal core's own default.settings.php documents this setting, ships it as FALSE, and describes changing it as a temporary measure.

finding.assertion: The observed settings declare update_free_access as TRUE.

conclusion.candidate: The access check appears disabled, though the deciding context was not fully observed.
conclusion.confirmed: The access check in front of update.php is disabled by the observed settings declaration.
conclusion.not_observed: The observed settings do not declare update_free_access as true.
conclusion.unknown: The declared value could not be established.

finding.evidence_explanation: A settings declaration of update_free_access with value true was observed.
finding.human_title: update.php access control is switched off
limitations: Included settings files are not followed, so a later assignment could override this.

remediation.guidance: Drupal core ships this setting as FALSE. Restore it unless an update is actively in progress and the access check is being bypassed deliberately.

review.authority: reviewed against the pinned default.settings.php snapshot

scope.notes: The setting exists in Drupal 8 and later.

summary: $settings['update_free_access'] is declared TRUE, which removes the access check in front of the update.php script.
title: update.php access control is disabled
